text:
maria: Quick sync — need to finalize scope for our enterprise compliance lane for Q3. Customer asks: per-tenant audit exports, BYOK onboarding + KMS escrow, SOC2 evidence packaging, and an optional 7yr retention. We need clear launch criteria and obvious tradeoffs. Can we split must-haves vs nice-to-haves and call out ops/cost impact?

liam: From runtime: per-tenant audit export API + export UI is feasible but adds ~15% ingestion/storage cost if we index everything. Option: exports as cold-archive (S3) + optional indexed preview to cut cost. BYOK onboarding API requires a handshake flow + attestation; engineering ETA ~6w for API + basic test harness.

priya: Security notes: BYOK must use HSM-backed KMS integration and a defined escrow process. Need an attestation artifact (signed policy + key fingerprint) and rotation windows documented. SOC2 evidence packaging needs immutable snapshot + manifest + integrity hashes (recommend sha256). Also: 7yr retention raises legal/PII review — default cannot be >90d without special contract.

ethan: Customer-facing: three pilot customers prioritized exports + BYOK. Their acceptance criteria: export available within 24h SLA, exported package includes manifest + hashes, & onboarding flow with concierge-assisted key onboarding. They prefer phased approach: exports (read-only) -> automated ingest connectors.

maria: Proposed MVP gates: 1) BYOK onboarding API + escrow doc + runbook (onboarding playbook and support checklist); 2) per-tenant export API + UI + 24h export SLA and E2E test; 3) evidence snapshot format (jsonl payload + manifest + sha256) and SOC2 checklist mapping. Anything missing?

liam: Agree overall. Suggest we exclude long-term retention (>1yr) from MVP and add to roadmap as "Archival+Retention v2". Also call out we need an E2E integration test harness that replays tenant activity and validates export manifests. That adds ~2w to timeline.

priya: One more: legal needs explicit tenant opt-in for retention >90d and a tenant-level retention flag. Also require proof-of-wipe runbook for when customers end contract. For BYOK, require key attestation + periodic audit log export to show key usage.

maria: Action items and owners: liam — final ETA + test harness spec; priya — security acceptance criteria + retention opt-in policy draft; ethan — coordinate pilot customers and define acceptance tests; legal-bot — link to any existing contract templates. Can we aim for sign-off by 1764511200?

legal-bot: Draft contract/keystore addendum uploaded: https://docs.redwood.ai/compliance/byok-escrow-draft (please review for retention language).

maria: Thanks — I'll assemble a short roadmap doc with clear launch gates and tradeoffs after we have the ETA and sec criteria. If anyone has objections to excluding >1yr retention from MVP, speak now.

ethan: No objections from pilots — they'd rather us ship exports early.

liam: No objection.

priya: No objection, but we must keep retention opt-in gating in the UI and API.

maria: Cool — I'll publish the draft roadmap + acceptance checklist once liam/priya post updates. :thumbsup:
